# External Data and Attribution

## Current status

PlantGuard uses course-generated synthetic data. The project owner confirmed
with course management that generated data is sufficient for the submission.

No separately downloaded public sensor dataset is required for the current
submission scope, based on that clarification.

## Important distinction

Public datasets named in the course toolkit manifest are source references
used for grounding schema or distributions. Their appearance in the manifest
does not mean their original records are included in this project.

Do not claim that an external dataset was incorporated unless its actual
files, source, and licence have been verified.

## Attribution and licensing policy

If external data is added in the future, document:

- Dataset title and original source URL
- Version or download date
- Licence and attribution requirements
- Files incorporated and any transformations performed
- Whether redistribution is permitted

Until then, the PlantGuard operational dataset should be described as
synthetic, course-generated data. No external dataset licence is claimed
for synthetic records generated by the toolkit.
